# Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

source("R/setup.R")
library(gtsummary) # Essential for Table 1 generation
library(ggstats)   # Helper for gtsummary plots (optional)

# Load the finalized dataset from the validation step
# Note: Ensure this file was saved at the end of 02_data-validation.qmd
gic_validated <- readRDS(here("data", "processed", "gic_validated.rds"))
```

# Baseline Characteristics
```{r}
#| label: tbl-numeric-manual
#| results: asis

# Define numeric vars to summarize
num_vars <- c("bmi_0", "weight_0", "height_0", "cycles_given")

# Calculate Stats
num_summary <- gic_validated |> 
  filter(!is.na(hiv_status)) |> 
  group_by(hiv_status) |> 
  summarise(
    across(all_of(num_vars), 
           ~ paste0(round(mean(., na.rm = TRUE), 1), " (", round(sd(., na.rm = TRUE), 1), ")"))
  ) |> 
  pivot_longer(-hiv_status, names_to = "Variable", values_to = "Value") |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = hiv_status, values_from = Value)

# Print
num_summary |> 
  kbl(booktabs = TRUE, caption = "Baseline Numerics (Mean + SD)") |> 
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-categorical-manual
#| results: asis

library(janitor)

# Define categorical vars to summarize
cat_vars <- c("sex", "cancer_stage", "residence", "comorbid_htn")

# Loop through them and print small tables
walk(cat_vars, function(var) {
  
  # Create Title
  cat(paste0("\n**", var, "**\n"))
  
  # Make the table
  tbl <- gic_validated |> 
    filter(!is.na(hiv_status)) |> 
    tabyl(!!sym(var), hiv_status) |> 
    adorn_percentages("col") |> 
    adorn_pct_formatting(digits = 1) |> 
    adorn_ns(position = "front") 
  
  # Print kable
  print(
    tbl |> 
      kbl(booktabs = TRUE) |> 
      kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "left")
  )
  
  cat("\n<br>\n") # Space between tables
})
```
